If a property entry field is unknown,
warn and discard the field.

-- test.glx --
persons:
    someone:
        properties:
            name:
                value: Someone
                fields:
                    unknown_field: "unknown field"
                    surname: "Known Field"

-- want-errors --
persons\[someone\].Properties.name: field discarded: unknown field "unknown_field"

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
    someone:
        properties:
            name:
                definition:
                    label: Name
                    value_type: string
                entries:
                -   value: StringValue{"Someone"}
                    fields:
                        # unknown_field discarded, but known "surname" field retained.
                        surname:
                            definition:
                                label: Surname
                            value: StringValue{"Known Field"}
